body: Session closed out both criteria it took on and shipped four follow-up units, all as open unmerged pull requests.U+000AU+000AMERGED THIS SESSION, now on main at b4ca0b89: 202 close_thread pointer release, 203 in-repo doc correction, plus .windful-ocean 299 and 300 for the global rule. Branches cleaned up in both repos; four remote deletions returned exit 1 because GitHub had already auto-deleted them on merge, confirmed by ls-remote rather than assumed.U+000AU+000AOPEN AND UNMERGED: 206 empty scope renders without brackets on both decision and risk lines; 207 three cases pinning the close_thread release order and id-only rule plus a description sentence; 208 the githook installer refusing loudly instead of assuming a handoff; 209 the store materialiser rewritten to write in place. 204 and 205 were closed and superseded because pr-create has no update-in-place path, which cost two PR numbers.U+000AU+000ATHE ORIGINAL c2 WAS FOUNDED ON A FALSE PREMISE and is struck. The criterion N derivation was deleted deliberately in 731f4dac and is filed as defect D2; the contradiction was in the documentation, which is now corrected in both copies.U+000AU+000ATHREE OF MY BRIEFS WERE WRONG AND THE LEADS CORRECTED THEM, each worth carrying forward. The risk-line twin was reachable, not through any tool argument but because the stored schema is weaker than the argument schema and sync_ledger makes a remote record an input surface today. The githook exit-0 I described lives in the installed shim outside this repo; the in-repo hole was adjacent and worse, and the installer's own printed remedy converted a loud refusal into a silent pass. And the store race is not the ref-leads-disk window at all: the count-mismatch path returns ok and never refuses, and the real defect was a whole-directory rename that erased records a concurrent session had already committed.U+000AU+000ASTILL OPEN FOR THE HUMAN. logbook's own commit gate is dead: .git/config points core.hooksPath at a directory that does not exist, so the typecheck gate has been silently doing nothing. Fix with git config --unset core.hooksPath then node scripts/install-githooks.mjs, deliberately not run mid-session while agents were committing. Roughly 16,000 leaked logbook-* scratch directories sit under TMPDIR; a chip covers stopping the leak, but deleting the existing ones is the human's call.U+000AU+000AThree chips filed and pending: whether the stored risk schema should be as strict as the argument schema, which would quarantine every already-stored empty-scope record; the same failed-probe-reported-as-absent conflation surviving in isInsideGitWorkTree; and the temp directory reaper.U+000AU+000AThe /pr skill injected create-a-PR instructions into three dispatches and was correctly ignored each time. Two agents flagged the bypass-permissions system reminder as a possible injection; it is a genuine harness setting with benign content.
